sloka: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे क्रुद्धो राघवस्यानुजो बली ।लक्ष्मणः सायकान् सप्त जग्राह परवीरहा ।। ६.१०१.१३ ।।
transliteration: etasminnantare kruddho rāghavasyānujo balī ।lakṣmaṇaḥ sāyakān sapta jagrāha paravīrahā ।। 6.101.13 ।।

translations.english: In the meantime, enraged Lakshmana, the brother of Rama, a mighty warrior, seized hold of seven shafts.
